description:
We are building an AI-driven decision-support platform for Field Shift that fuses NASA Earth observations (POWER, SMAP, GPM, MODIS) with local soil data to help farmers choose climate-resilient crop rotations.

Our Stack: Full-Stack Web (React, Python), Geospatial Analytics & AI/ML.

Looking for teammates skilled in: • Data Visualization & UI/UX Design • Earth Science / Agriculture Domain Knowledge • Storytelling & Pitching

Let’s build an impactful solution for Coimbatore!
summary: Climate variability and shifting monsoons threaten smallholder agricultural productivity across South Asia. In coastal and riverine farming regions, farmers struggle to decide what to plant across three annual seasons as rainfall arrives late, dry spells intensify, and soil salinity creeps inland. Field Shift translates raw NASA Earth observations (NASA POWER, GPM IMERG, SMAP L4, MODIS 250m NDVI, and MERRA-2) into ranked, explainable 3-season crop rotation strategies on a single screen. Combining machine-learning monsoon onset forecasting, multimodal Gemini 2.0 Flash plant disease diagnostics, Turf.js geodesic field area computation, and live 7-day weather alerts, Field Shift empowers farmers to adapt their agricultural calendars with confidence in their native languages (English, Bengali, and Tamil). Every recommendation shows the exact satellite data points, environmental penalties, and positive agronomic benefits behind its score. Built with Next.js 16 and open-source science.
details: What does it do or how does it work? Field Shift is an explainable decision-support platform for smallholder farmers facing shifting monsoon patterns, coastal soil salinity, and climate volatility. It ingests historical satellite climate feeds (NASA POWER, GPM IMERG, SMAP, MODIS, MERRA-2) to evaluate and rank thousands of 3-season crop rotation strategies for local fields. The platform features an offline-first rotation engine, a backtested machine-learning monsoon onset predictor, a multimodal Gemini 2.0 Flash plant disease diagnostic scanner (/disease), a Turf.js geodesic field area calculator (/locate), and 7-day micro-weather alerts. Every recommendation provides transparent SHAP-style factor contributions, penalty breakdowns, and SMS-ready advisory text. What benefits does it have and intended impact? 1. Reduces Climate Vulnerability: Shifts crop sowing calendars to synchronize with actual usable rainfall rather than outdated historical calendars. 2. Prevents Soil Degradation: Recommends nitrogen-fixing legumes and green manures to replenish organic matter and break pest/pathogen cycles. 3. Language & Digital Equity: Fully localized in English, Bengali (বাংলা), and Tamil (தமிழ்), with Web Speech voice priority controls and offline PWA capability to ensure zero barrier for rural smallholders. What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use? - Framework & Web: Next.js 16.3.6 App Router, React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS v4, View Transitions API. - AI & ML: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash Multimodal Vision API, Chrome 127+ On-Device Gemini Nano (window.ai), Scikit-learn conformal prediction for monsoon onset. - Geospatial & Climate: Turf.js GIS engine, Open-Meteo 7-day weather API, NASA POWER point APIs, GPM IMERG precipitation grids. - Testing & Deployment: Vitest (701 passing tests), GitHub, Vercel edge deployment. How is your project creative? Rather than treating agricultural advice as a black-box prediction, Field Shift makes every recommendation mathematically transparent. Farmers see the exact penalty points deducted for drought or salinity risks and positive bonuses awarded for early monsoon onset or soil recovery. Its multimodal Crop Doctor combines satellite planning with field-level plant pathology, enabling farmers to break pathogen cycles through crop rotation. Major System Upgrades & Decision-Support Features: 1. Adaptation Margin Stress-Testing: Quantifies safe late-monsoon onset buffer (+15 to +25 days) and soil salinity buffer (dS/m) before rotation turnaround failure or yield loss. 2. Sustainability ROI & Resource Scorecard: Real-time calculation of conserved groundwater (+1,950 m³/ha), diesel pumping fuel saved (~24 L / BDT 2,500/ha), biological nitrogen fixation (+42 kg N/ha via legume nodulation), and soil organic carbon sequestration (+0.35 t CO₂e/ha/yr). 3. Trilingual Audio Advisory (Text-to-Speech): Web Speech Synthesis audio readout in Tamil (தமிழ்), Bengali (বাংলা), and English for illiterate and low-vision smallholder farmers. 4. NASA GIBS Live Satellite Observation Viewer (/satellite): Real-time embedding of NASA Terra/Aqua MODIS 250m True Color, VIIRS 375m, and SMAP L4 root-zone soil moisture over regional fields.
